errors.evidence: The horizontal axis does have visible tick marks and intervals, though no explicit label. The description incorrectly states there are no visible divisions or intervals.

The color for Croatia is described as 'light blue' (светлосиньо), but the image shows a standard blue. While this is a reasonable synonym, the atom checklist specifies 'синьо' (blue), so this is a minor discrepancy.
The description does not explicitly state the purpose of the chart (illustrating perceptions of the shadow economy and undeclared activities in four countries). This is a critical omission.
The description omits mentioning the vertical axis labels and their arrangement, though it lists the categories. The reference explicitly describes the vertical axis structure.

The description does not mention that the first two categories (QD9 and QD7) have the highest number of opinions, nor does it explicitly state that Bulgaria has the most votes in the remaining three categories while Romania has the fewest. This is a partial omission of key trends.
The description does not explicitly state that the bars are grouped by category, though this is implied. The atom checklist specifies this as important.

errors.text_span: Диаграмата представлява групирана хоризонтална стълбовидна визуализация, която показва числови стойности за четири държави (Хърватия, Румъния, Гърция и България) по пет тематични категории, свързани със „сива икономика“ и „недекларирани дейности“, като всяка категория съдържа по четири хоризонтални стълба (по един за държава) с изписана стойност в края на стълба.
